items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: I just knew him by seeing him playing, you know.

ctx.x: T-boy. T-boy. That was T-boy. Yeah. T-boy. Yeah. We might look at that picture if you don't mind for a minute and tell us who else is on there. Last week Joe Harris told us he got a little mixed up on it. He thought it was Riley. He thought it was something. Riley or somebody on trumpet. I forget. But his father I think is on there, isn't it? Yeah. Mr. Harris. Yeah, his dad is on there. Yeah, yeah. Well, that's the only ones that I know their name. Now, there's a man I know you know.

I just passed his picture. Yeah, we can come back to those. Oh, yeah. Oh, Jimmy Noon, yes. Oh, yes. Did you know him? Yeah. You knew him. I wonder if you could tell us anything about him. Well, no, I couldn't. I just knew him by seeing him playing, you know. I see.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
